chapter: Leaving Stuff Smith; Benny Carter and Fletcher Henderson
title: Chicago hotel jobs in 1940, sharing a stand with Eddie Condon's band
summary: After the Onyx and California the Stuff Smith group played the Three Deuces, La Salle, Sherman and Cincinnati's Netherlands Plaza; at the Sherman Condon's band, with Bud Freeman, shared the stand.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well, I left him, I think the last job was the Sherman Hotel. Well, now we started doing the hotels. I said the La Salle, and then from the La Salle we did the Three Deuces first in Chicago, and then to the La Salle Hotel, and then into the Sherman. They had both bands on the stand, Eddie Condon's with Bud Freeman in it, and our band. And there the two bands played together on the stand. Then, from there, into Cincinnati, the Netherlands Plaza, downstairs. People were trying to book us on good jobs then. And now he gets here to the Green Lantern Room in the Edison Hotel, and he --
All right, Jonah, just talk right there.
Yeah, that's about right. All right.
And then you worked the Sherman?
At the Sherman. We were in there with Condon and his band, and it was a great engagement, playing together, and then from there --
No, this is -- no, because this was after the Onyx.
We went to the Onyx in '36 and '37. We went out there about June of '37, I think we went out to --
